'''''Flowers of Drall''''' was a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] anthem.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] [[Champhra Biahin]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall's]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], sent a recording of ''Flowers of Drall'' sung by young students at the [[Boiling Sea Music Academy]] on Drall to the chairperson of the [[Dearic Garden Club]] as a token of gratitude for the club's help in procuring a sample of the rare [[Twin-Scented Natterbloom]].
